crossRefs.note: The servant therefore fell down and knelt before him, saying, ‘Lord, have patience with me, and I will repay you all!’
Forgive us our debts, as we also forgive our debtors.
But if he has wronged you at all or owes you anything, put that to my account.
I, Paul, write this with my own hand: I will repay it (not to mention to you that you owe to me even your own self…

translations.web: “So his fellow servant fell down at his feet and begged him, saying, ‘Have patience with me, and I will repay you!’
translations.bsb: So his fellow servant fell down and begged him, ‘Have patience with me, and I will pay you back.’
translations.kjv: And his fellowservant fell down at his feet, and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee all.
translations.asv: So his fellow-servant fell down and besought him, saying, Have patience with me, and I will pay thee.
